name: v2_haiku-nothink
description: 4Minds RAG v2: the metrics of v1 with the same settings; only the judge is different. Judge: Claude Haiku 5.5 with thinking disabled.

judge.note: The backend entry removes temperature and top_p (Haiku 5.5 rejects them) and disables thinking. drop_params also removes the RAGAS response_format {"type": "json_object"}: the Anthropic OpenAI-compatible endpoint accepts only json_schema (HTTP 400). The JSON schema instructions of the RAGAS prompt stay; the code fence around the JSON is removed before parsing.

metrics.label: Answer Accuracy (RAGAS, NVIDIA)
metrics.note: The question and the answer against the gold answer; two judge ratings (0, 2 or 4), each with the roles swapped, scaled to 0-1 and averaged.

metrics.label: Factual Correctness (RAGAS)
metrics.note: Claims of the answer checked against the gold answer (precision) and claims of the gold answer checked against the answer (recall); F1 from the same TP, FP and FN, with the formulas of FactualCorrectness.

metrics.label: Summarization (DeepEval)
metrics.note: The original text is the gold facts of the question, the same for every system. The 5 assessment questions are made once per question by `pipeline/score_extra.py prepare` and used for every system. Score = min(alignment, coverage).

metrics.label: Hallucination (DeepEval; higher is better)
metrics.note: Context is the gold facts, one context item per fact. The score is the fraction of facts that the answer does not contradict, so "I don't know" scores 1.

metrics.label: Document retrieval (no judge)
metrics.note: The document IDs that the system gave against the original gold document IDs (no correction); only questions with gold documents. Precision is 0 when the system gave no documents.
